Diagnosis: Left breast invasive ductal carcinoma (NST), upper outer quadrant, Nottingham grade 3. ER Allred 8/8, PR 6/8, HER2 negative (IHC 1+), Ki-67 35%.
Stage: pT2 (28 mm) pN1a (2/14 nodes) M0, prognostic stage IIB. Margins clear.
Surgery: left mastectomy and axillary node clearance on 21/01/2026 (Mr Oluwaseun Adeyemi-Clarke).
Relevant history: classical Hodgkin lymphoma aged 19, treated with ABVD x6 and mantle-field radiotherapy at Penhallow Royal Infirmary in 1990.
Performance status: ECOG 0.

Peggy was discussed at the Breast MDT on Thursday 26 February 2026 and I saw her in clinic today with her husband Gareth.

MDT outcome and plan
1. Adjuvant chemotherapy. Because of her previous doxorubicin (ABVD) and mantle irradiation we will avoid a further anthracycline: docetaxel 75 mg/m2 + cyclophosphamide 600 mg/m2 (TC), 3-weekly x 6 cycles with G-CSF support. Cycle 1 is booked for 2026-03-16.
2. Baseline echo 24/02/26: LVEF 58%, no regional wall motion abnormality. Repeat after cycle 3.
3. Then ovarian suppression (goserelin) plus an aromatase inhibitor for at least 5 years; she also meets criteria for 2 years of abemaciclib (node-positive, grade 3).
4. Dr Eleri Prys-Jones (clinical oncology) has reviewed her old radiotherapy records and advises against post-mastectomy radiotherapy because of overlap with the mantle field.
5. Germline genetic testing requested: her sister Bronwen was diagnosed with ovarian cancer at 44.
6. Peggy has consented to HEART-SAFE, a cardiac surveillance study for patients with prior chest irradiation (participant ID HS-NKH-0419).

Her weight rose by 4 kg after surgery, which we discussed. The scar has healed well, there is no lymphoedema, and BP was 128/76. She is a teaching assistant at St Aldhelm's C of E Primary School in Wrenfold and will stay off work until after cycle 6.

Siobhán Ní Bhriain (breast CNS) will see her before cycle 1 for chemotherapy education and to discuss scalp cooling. I will review her in 3/52 and again in 3/12 at the end of chemotherapy.

Yours sincerely,

Dr R. K. Venkataraghavan

Stage: cT2b N2 M0, stage IIIA (AJCC 8th ed.)
ECOG 1. FEV1 1.62 L (61% pred), DLCO 52%. BP 142/88. No Horner syndrome or Pancoast features; Dr Horner agrees he is not fit for lobectomy.

MDM recommendations
1. Definitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy: carboplatin AUC 2 + paclitaxel 45 mg/m2 weekly x 6, with 60 Gy in 30 fractions under Dr Kwame Asante-Mensah (Radiation Oncology).
2. Consolidation durvalumab 10 mg/kg fortnightly for up to 12 months if no progression on restaging.
3. Stan has consented to the RE-BREATHE trial of supervised exercise during chemoradiation (screening no. RB3/BLK/0057).
